parts.text: Which claim about the forces on the lunch box is correct?

options.text: Balanced forces act on the lunch box, including the push between the table and the lunch box, so it stays at rest.
No force acts on the lunch box because it is not moving.
An object at rest always has an unbalanced force acting on it.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

stem: Jyoti's steel lunch box sits at rest on the table. It does not move.

part_answers.answer: Rest does not mean zero force; balanced forces can keep an object still.

teacher.key_rationale: An object at rest can have forces on it that cancel. The table pushes up on the lunch box; that balanced set keeps it still. 'Not moving' alone does not mean no force, and rest does not require an unbalanced force.
